# Ezekiel 42 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 42:1 (overlap: 9%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-brought-me-out to the-outer court, the-way-of the-north, and-brought-me to the-chamber which [was] opposite the-separate-area and opposite the-building to-the-north. |
| LOGOS | Then he led me out into the outer court, toward the north, and he brought me to the chamber that was opposite the separate yard and opposite the building on the north. |
| PNEUMA | Then the man led me out of the inner courtyard through the north gateway. He brought me to the group of rooms across from the open area and the building to the north. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
